description: Make the build output directory an order-only prerequisite of every .o rule, so a parallel build (-j) doesn't race multiple mkdir calls or fail because the directory disappears mid-build
prompts: The Makefile's %.o rule calls `mkdir -p build` as its FIRST recipe line, every single time it runs - under a parallel build (`make -j`), several .o rules can run mkdir -p concurrently, which is normally harmless, but the rule ALSO lists `build` as a normal (order-only-unaware) side effect with no formal dependency at all, so Make has no idea the directory needs to exist before the recipe runs and doesn't serialize or track it as a prerequisite - if the directory gets removed between the mkdir and the compile step (e.g. a concurrent `make clean`), the build breaks with no clear dependency to blame. Fix it properly: add `build` as an ORDER-ONLY prerequisite (after a `|` in the prerequisite list) of the pattern rule, with its own rule `build:` that does `mkdir -p build` - remove the `mkdir -p build` recipe line from inside %.o entirely, since Make itself now guarantees the directory exists (and is up to date) before the recipe runs, via the order-only prerequisite mechanism.

setup_files.Makefile:
CC = gcc
CFLAGS = -Wall

app: build/main.o
	$(CC) -o app build/main.o

build/%.o: %.c
	mkdir -p build
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c $< -o $@

.PHONY: clean
clean:
	rm -rf app build

test_setup_files.test_order_only.py:
import re
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

src = Path('Makefile').read_text(encoding='utf-8')

pattern_rule = re.search(r'^build/%\.o\s*:\s*%\.c\s*\|\s*build\s*$', src, re.MULTILINE)
assert pattern_rule, (
    "expected 'build/%.o: %.c | build' with build as an order-only prerequisite (after a '|')")

build_rule = re.search(r'^build\s*:\s*$', src, re.MULTILINE)
assert build_rule, "expected a standalone 'build:' rule that creates the directory"

pattern_recipe_start = pattern_rule.end()
next_rule = re.search(r'^\S', src[pattern_recipe_start + 1:], re.MULTILINE)
recipe_block = src[pattern_recipe_start:pattern_recipe_start + 1 + (next_rule.start() if next_rule else len(src))]
assert 'mkdir -p build' not in recipe_block, (
    "the %.o recipe must not call 'mkdir -p build' itself anymore - the order-only "
    "prerequisite on 'build' is what's supposed to guarantee the directory exists")

r = subprocess.run(['make', 'app'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=45)
assert r.returncode == 0, f'make app failed: {r.stdout}\n{r.stderr}'
assert Path('app').exists(), 'app was not built'
out = subprocess.run(['./app'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15).stdout.strip()
assert out == 'ok', f'unexpected output: {out!r}'

print('PASS')
